name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: PROACTIVE-ONLY BUILD (v0.6.3): same three-trigger architecture and CA-excluding email filter as v0.6.1/v0.6.2 (1. compose-window-open -> unconditional CertVerifier rebuild; 2. send button/menu intercepted before the real send -> duplicate-only cleanup, no reinit, original send runs exactly once; 3. shutdown -> duplicate-only cleanup; no retry), with the filter fixed to use the API that actually exists: nsIX509Cert exposes emailAddresses only as the METHOD getEmailAddresses() (and the AString attribute emailAddress) -- there is no 'emailAddresses' property. v0.6.1's filter crashed on cert.emailAddresses.length (TypeError), v0.6.2's null-guard silently treated every cert as having no email, so doCleanup() saw 0 live certs and the stale duplicate was never deleted, breaking signing; getEmailAddresses().length correctly returns the real addresses from Subject/SAN so ext.test-style signing certs are kept and chain-only CA certs (no email) are still excluded.
